gaps.title: Three open [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] items for the owner (they do not block P0)
gaps.evidence: spec.md:550-554: (1) offer an opt-in to merge a clean diverged sync directly instead of opening a PR; (2) allow a schedule below hourly for paying accounts; (3) offer Actions hygiene on linked repositories. Defaults are stated (always a PR, hourly minimum, no hygiene on links), and P0 (T1–T8) touches none of them. Decision (1) matters more because of G02: with R-4 every App Work sync takes the PR path.
gaps.proposedFix: The owner decides; record the answers in spec §9 and, if changed, in FR-32/FR-36/FR-31 and plan §6.3/§6.7.

gaps.title: ACC-E2E-05 expects Upstream sync in the Schedules view, but no epic puts it there
gaps.evidence: ACCEPTANCE L349-350 and traceability row 3 (L1313, L1334) require that 'the Schedules view lists the Upstream sync with the spec's cron expression'. APW-02 runs sync from its own dispatcher (`app-upstream-sync-dispatcher`, plan L766; CONTRACTS §5) and adds only the Upstream tab (FR-59). No APW-02 or APW-01 task writes an entry or provider into the existing Schedules surface, which today lists only Task, Mission and Goal schedules (EXISTING-SUBSTRATE L107). Owner step 3 names 'schedules' explicitly.
gaps.proposedFix: Either add an APW-02 task that contributes App Work upstream-sync (and, optionally, App spec `cron`) rows to the Schedules view, read-only with next-run time, or change ACC-E2E-05 to assert the schedule on the Upstream tab.

gaps.title: Activity rows lack required fields and web labels, and telemetry adds a package dependency the agent does not have
gaps.evidence: packages/agent/src/entities/activity-log.types.ts:427-433 requires userId, status and summary. Plan §6 (plan.md:614-617, 639-649) defines only action, actionType and details, and names no acting user for webhook- or cron-triggered events. APW-02 tasks.md:421 and APW-08 tasks.md:426 add ActivityTypeBadge colours and i18n for their families; APW-03 T2 (tasks.md:54-66) does not, so app_spec, app_blueprint and app_license render as raw text (apps/web/src/components/activity-log/ActivityTypeBadge.tsx:29-49). T49 (tasks.md:629-635) makes agent services emit through @ever-works/monitoring, which packages/agent/package.json does not depend on; the established pattern is a narrow capture-client port (packages/agent/src/services/knowledge-base-reconcile.service.ts:55-67).
gaps.proposedFix: Add per-event summary copy, status and the userId rule (Work owner for system triggers) to plan §6. Add ActivityTypeBadge, ActivityFilters and i18n entries to T2/T18. Rewrite T49 to use an injected capture-client token wired by the API.

gaps.title: APW-10 T31 would put environment and port reads into APW-03's deliberately pure availability function
gaps.evidence: APW-10 tasks.md:506-512 (T31) modifies packages/agent/src/apps-catalog/apps-catalog.mapper.ts to 'read AppsTierPolicy.isOpen() and managedScope()', with Done when 'mapper no longer reads EVER_WORKS_APPS_MANAGED_ENABLED'. APW-03 T23 (tasks.md:338) makes the mapper pure, with tier state passed in and nothing read from process.env; T24 (tasks.md:343-345) and plan.md:216 read the port in AppsCatalogService.
gaps.proposedFix: Rewrite APW-10 T31 as a verification-only task (assert the service-level wiring and add the ACC-03-48 cases against APW-10's real policy), or delete its mapper modification. Keep managedHostingAvailability pure.

gaps.title: Budget-override approval wiring (payload and listener) is unnamed
gaps.evidence: T22 (tasks.md:307-315) creates a budget_override proposal 'through the existing proposal producer' and says 'approval patches tokenCap'. The existing path is AgentApprovalsService.createProposal (agent-approvals.service.ts:144) plus an @OnEvent listener on AgentActionProposalDecidedEvent (agent-action-proposal-decided.event.ts; pattern in email/email-draft-approval.listener.ts). No payload shape ({ kind, provisioningId, capKind, delta }), listener class, or decidedVia rule is specified.
gaps.proposedFix: Specify the payload discriminator and fields, an AppProvisionCapApprovalListener, and that only decidedVia 'user' raises the cap.

gaps.title: createFromRepoTemplate must validate 'required keys' that are defined only in the external catalog schema
gaps.evidence: T2 (tasks.md:50-56) and plan.md:607-612 say 'validate the manifest's required keys' and 'the catalog schema's required keys'. The draft agent.yml:2-6 claims ever-works/agents schema/agent-manifest.schema.json requires the companion files. That schema is not in this monorepo, and AgentTemplateCatalogService only reads manifest.json rows (apps/api/src/agents/agent-template-catalog.service.ts:38-46). The key list is not written anywhere in the docs.
gaps.proposedFix: List the required agent.yml keys (and allowed values for scope, permissions and similar) in plan §7.1 so T2's test can be written offline, and cite the schema version.

gaps.title: Licence and terms for suggested App specs are undecided, blocking the P3 consent copy
gaps.evidence: spec.md:600 asks which license a suggested App spec carries in the catalog. The consent text 'I agree to publish this App spec under the catalog's terms' (spec.md:494-496) and T38/T39 (tasks.md:486-509) cannot name the terms.
gaps.proposedFix: Owner picks the licence for contributed Blueprint specs (for example MIT, matching the Skill), and the consent copy and the bundle's license field cite it.

gaps.title: The workflow_run consumer cannot import the dispatcher as tasked, because IngestModule does not export it
gaps.evidence: apps/api/src/ingest/ingest.module.ts:131-149 provides GitHubWebhookDispatcherService but exports only `[EventIngestModule]`; both existing consumers (github-check-intake.service.ts:461, github-issue-intake.service.ts:218) live inside IngestModule. T24 (tasks.md:364-367) says 'import the ingest module's exported dispatcher' and lists no change to apps/api/src/ingest/ingest.module.ts or its spec.
gaps.proposedFix: In T24, either add `GitHubWebhookDispatcherService` to IngestModule.exports (and extend ingest.module.spec.ts), or register the consumer as a provider inside IngestModule, importing only the agent-side services it needs.

gaps.title: 'verifyEnabled' is undefined, and the +30-minute job timeout can break FR-24's timeout for ordinary Builds
gaps.evidence: plan.md:168 sets the build job's `timeout-minutes` to `build.resources.timeoutMinutes + (30 when a verification plan may run)`, and plan.md:664 puts `verifyEnabled` into the canonical inputs, but nothing defines when it is true. The App Provisioner may verify any App Work at any time, so if it is always true every push Build gets timeoutMinutes + 30. That contradicts FR-24 and S20 (spec.md:265, 164-165: 'at 60 minutes the build stops … Took longer than 60 minutes'), and the classifier would report the wrong minutes.
gaps.proposedFix: Define verifyEnabled. Better, keep the job timeout at timeoutMinutes, enforce a step-level `timeout-minutes` on the build step, and apply the extra 30 minutes only to the verify step (already at plan.md:221). Pin this in the T8 golden files.

gaps.title: The live fixture mapping omits two variant branches and uses a different failure-class name from APW-13
gaps.evidence: T31 (tasks.md:441-445) maps ACC-05 onto variant/build-oom, services-postgres, missing-value, secret-in-image and dockerfile-error. APW-13 T58 also creates variant/build-timeout and variant/disk-full for ACC-05-17's timeout and diskFull cases (APW-13 tasks.md:532-541; ACCEPTANCE.md:1291-1293), and T31 does not list them. APW-13 plan.md:213 expects build-oom to produce 'reason `out_of_memory`', while APW-05's class is `outOfMemory` (spec.md:481, 586).
gaps.proposedFix: Add variant/build-timeout and variant/disk-full to T31 and the ACCEPTANCE APW-05 intro. Change APW-13 plan §4.3's row to failure class `outOfMemory`.

gaps.title: i18n leaf keys and English copy are missing for precondition, failure, phase and notification strings
gaps.evidence: T41 (tasks.md:546-551) and plan.md:1020-1032 name only subtrees: `preconditions.*` with 'one per §5.1 code' (about 30 codes at plan.md:488-503), `failures.*`, `phases.*` (11), `health.*`, `jobs.*`, `cron.*`, `logs.*`. Spec §6.7 (spec.md:633-651) gives English copy for a subset only; for example `cluster_changed_unconfirmed`, `managed_sandbox_unavailable`, `volume_shrink`, `worker_not_isolated`, `job_auth_env_unset` and the four notification titles have none. README §7 rule 11 requires each key in en.json. Implementers would invent user-facing copy.
gaps.proposedFix: Add an i18n table to plan §10.3 listing each leaf key (camelCase) with its final English copy for all §5.1 precondition codes, §5.4 failure codes, the 11 phases, the health states and the notification titles and bodies. Mark each entry that spec §6.7 already covers.

gaps.title: Status reasons and error codes the plan uses have no i18n keys or copy
gaps.evidence: The i18n reason list (plan.md:739) covers 10 codes. The plan also emits `namespacePoliciesMissing` (plan.md:535), `noStorage` (plan.md:541), `outputsUnavailable` (plan.md:765), `operatorSkipped` (plan.md:764) and the API errors `providerNotSupported`, `dependencyNotDeclared`, `confirmationMismatch`, `deleteInProgress`, `notGenerated` (plan.md:652-655), none of which have keys under `dashboard.workDetail.appDependencies`. Spec copy also lacks text for them. Activity type badges map `actionType` through a fixed table (apps/web/src/components/activity-log/ActivityTypeBadge.tsx:29-48), and no key is listed for `app_env`/`app_dependency`. ACC-07-25 requires every string to be translated.
gaps.proposedFix: Close the vocabulary. List every status reason and API error code in `app-dependencies.ts`/`app-env.ts` constants, give each spec copy and a plan §8 key (plus `dashboard.activity.filters.types.appEnv|appDependency`), and add a test in T2 that every reason constant has an en.json key.

gaps.title: Job, repository and plugin wiring steps missing from T8, T17 and T22
gaps.evidence: T17 (tasks.md:220-227) omits `packages/tasks/src/trigger/trigger.service.ts` (each dispatcher needs a `dispatchXxx` method, e.g. line 700). It also omits the pinned arity in `packages/agent/src/tasks/__tests__/job-runtime.providers.spec.ts` ('Provider arity is pinned at 14', job-runtime.providers.ts:172-178). It doesn't define the delayed re-dispatch (5 min / ≤ 30 s); existing code uses `deferUntil` → `delay` (trigger.service.ts:581-591). T8 doesn't say whether the repositories go in `_repository-inventory.ts` (enforced by database.module.spec.ts:41) or in feature modules. T22's manifest omits `autoEnable`/`builtIn`/`visibility` (the k8s manifest has them), and `BaseFacadeService` selects only plugins enabled for the user (base.facade.ts:41-47), so a plugin that isn't enabled leaves SMTP/S3 unavailable. T3 copies plan §4.7 'exactly', which references an undefined `ResourceRefs` type.
gaps.proposedFix: Name the dispatcher method `dispatchAppDependencyProvision(payload)` with a `notBefore` field, the TriggerService and arity-spec edits, where the repositories are registered, the full plugin manifest flags (autoEnable, builtIn, visibility), and define `ResourceRefs` in the interface file.

gaps.title: The managed-tier 'overdue' backup threshold (24 h) contradicts FR-48 (26 h for every card)
gaps.evidence: spec.md:342-344 FR-48 defines 'Overdue — last completed {time} (older than 26 hours)' for every card. plan.md:608 and T37 (tasks.md:459-462) use 'older than 24 hours → overdue' for managed providers, and T37's test expects a 25-hour-old timestamp to read `overdue`, which FR-48 would call healthy. `APP_DEPENDENCY_BACKUP_OVERDUE_MS` is 26 h (plan.md:291).
gaps.proposedFix: Choose one. Either state in FR-48/FR-50 that managed cards use 24 h and add `APP_DEPENDENCY_MANAGED.backupMaxAgeMs` to the card logic explicitly, or use 26 h in T37 and change its test to 27 h.

gaps.title: P0 commit adapter ignores APW-02's checkout-key convention and shares the per-repository working copy
gaps.evidence: T3 (tasks.md:76-78) calls `cloneOrPull({ owner, repo, branch: base, autoSwitchToMainBranch: false })` with no `checkoutKey`. The facade keys working copies and in-flight operations by plugin/owner/repo/branch/switch only (git.facade.ts:1386-1392), and the directory is per owner-repo (EXISTING-SUBSTRATE.md:74). APW-02 P0 adds `checkoutKey` with the convention `work:<workId>:<role>` (APW-02 tasks.md:93-94; CONTRACTS.md:273). T2's lock serializes only commitToRepo calls on one workId, so other callers of the same data repository (e.g. generators that switch to main) can move the checkout under a commit.
gaps.proposedFix: In T3/T4, pass `checkoutKey: work:<workId>:agent-commit` once APW-02 P0 lands, and state the ordering between the two Wave 0 PRs. Otherwise document the residual hazard and add a test that a concurrent main-branch clone does not share the directory.

gaps.title: Five spec defaults are unconfirmed owner decisions (live-with-warnings, workflow-file protection, CI PRs on red, change Agent, follow-up budget)
gaps.evidence: spec.md:619-630 lists five [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] items, each with a chosen default that P1 builds on: closing on Live with warnings; blanket protection of `.github/workflows/**`; cloud runs opening PRs while a CI check is red; the last-Agent resolution rule vs an explicit per-App-Work setting; and 2 follow-ups per change / 3 open per Work vs a monthly budget. None blocks P0, but each changes P1 behaviour and tests (FR-20, FR-32, FR-37/38, FR-42).
gaps.proposedFix: Owner confirms or overrides each default before P1 starts. Record the decisions in spec §9 and remove the markers.

gaps.title: Telemetry task wires agent services to a package the agent package does not depend on
gaps.evidence: T30 (tasks.md:397-404) creates `packages/monitoring/src/posthog/upstream-pr-events.ts` and has 'the services of T15–T18 call emitUpstreamPrEvent'. `@ever-works/agent` depends only on @ever-works/agent-plugins, contracts and plugin (packages/agent/package.json). The in-repo precedent injects a PostHog client token instead (knowledge-base-reconcile.service.ts:61-106). No caller outside monitoring uses emitKbEvent. kb-events strips forbidden keys in production (kb-events.ts:211-228), while T30 says it throws.
gaps.proposedFix: Define an injectable `UPSTREAM_PR_TELEMETRY` port in packages/agent, bound in apps/api to the monitoring emitter, or put the event names and guard in contracts. Align the 'throws vs strips' behaviour with kb-events.

gaps.title: Registrations and cited helpers missing: repository inventory, agent-tool category, a non-exported helper
gaps.evidence: T7 (tasks.md:118-119) creates `upstream-pull-request.repository.ts` but does not modify `packages/agent/src/database/_repository-inventory.ts`, which DatabaseModule providers and database.module.spec.ts:41-50 are built from, so the repository is not injectable. T28 adds tool `suggestUpstreamContribution` without an entry in `ENTRY_POINT_CATEGORY` (packages/agent/src/safety/action-category.ts), so it runs as unclassified. plan.md:170 cites `neutralizeControlTokens`, a private function in apps/api/src/fleet/fleet-agent-task-planner.service.ts:77 that packages/agent cannot import.
gaps.proposedFix: Add `_repository-inventory.ts` to T7. Add `action-category.ts` (`suggestUpstreamContribution: 'write.internal'`) and its spec to T28. In T26, name a shared helper to create (e.g. export from packages/contracts) instead of citing the private function.

gaps.title: Review types and the summary rule are underspecified; the `head_repo` rule cannot be evaluated from its inputs
gaps.evidence: plan.md:354 gives `GitPullRequestReview` as `{ id, state, author, submittedAt, body }` with no types: id number or string, and no state union covering APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED/COMMENTED/DISMISSED/PENDING. No rule derives `reviewSummary` (latest review per reviewer? dismissed ignored?) or what happens after `seenReviewIds` reaches 200 (plan.md:210). T1 (tasks.md:45-46) sends `head_repo` 'only when headRepo differs from the head owner's fork name', a value `CreatePROptions` does not carry. GitHub needs head_repo when base and head repositories share an owner.
gaps.proposedFix: In plan §4, type `GitPullRequestReview { id: number; state: 'approved'|'changes_requested'|'commented'|'dismissed'|'pending'; author: string|null; submittedAt: string|null; body: string }`. Define the summary as the latest non-pending, non-dismissed review per author, with changes_requested beating approved beating commented. Evict the oldest seen ids beyond 200. Restate head_repo as 'sent when headOwner === owner'.

gaps.title: Owner decisions open: rate-limit numbers, a cap on contribution-run spend, and whether the approval always shows AI-policy evidence
gaps.evidence: spec.md:510-518 has [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] items: 'daily limit numbers' (1 per project per day, 3 overall; per-plan limits?), 'who pays for preparation? Should contribution runs have their own monthly cap?' and 'detecting no AI contributions … show a Checked the contribution guide for AI policy line'. Defaults exist in FR-26 and plan §3.3, so P1 is not blocked, but P2 needs the answers.
gaps.proposedFix: Owner confirms or changes the FR-26 numbers and per-plan overrides, decides on a separate monthly cap for contribution runs, and decides whether the approval always shows the AI-policy evidence line. Record the answers in spec §9 and README §8.

gaps.title: Stale or contradictory text: tab-ownership question already settled by R-8; ACC-E2E-08 budget contradicts its own deadline
gaps.evidence: spec.md:515-516 still carries '[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: Upstream tab ownership.] … whichever epic ships first creates the tab', though Resolution R-8 (CONTRACTS.md:51) and spec §6.1 (spec.md:345-348) settle it: APW-02 creates the tab. ACC-E2E-08's budget says '45 min (preparation ≤ 30 min + …)' (ACCEPTANCE.md:442), while the same scenario polls with 'hard deadline 90 min' (ACCEPTANCE.md:457) and FR-13 allows 90 minutes (spec.md:213).
gaps.proposedFix: Replace the tab-ownership clarification with 'Resolved by R-8'. Align the ACC-E2E-08 budget with the 90-minute preparation deadline (e.g. ≤ 105 min), or state a lower fixture-specific preparation expectation with the reason.

gaps.title: i18n keys are named only by namespace, with no rule for turning reason codes into keys
gaps.evidence: T21 (tasks.md:342-352) and T30 (tasks.md:498-499) list namespaces only: `admin.appsTier.board.*`, `outcomes.*`, `reasons.*`, `quarantine.*`, `dashboard.appsTier.eligibility.*`, `dashboard.workDetail.appsTier.*`. The only leaf key named is `lg01Title`…`lg25Title`. T21's spec must find a key for every SCREAMING_SNAKE reason code (e.g. `METADATA_REACHABLE`), but no conversion to a camelCase leaf is defined. Existing admin pages use `dashboard.adminUsage` and `dashboard.adminTenantRuntimeAllowlist` (en.json has no top-level `admin` namespace; `admin/usage/page.tsx:29`).
gaps.proposedFix: Add a key table to plan §8 mapping every spec §6 string to a leaf key. Define the conversion rule (e.g. `admin.appsTier.reasons.<camelCase(code)>`, so METADATA_REACHABLE → metadataReachable). Either keep the new top-level `admin` namespace with a note or align with `dashboard.adminAppsTier`.

gaps.title: The 'single-use, 15-minute' image pull credential on the managed tier has no producer
gaps.evidence: APW-10 FR-32 (spec L316-317): 'Private source images are pulled with a single-use credential sealed to the controller and valid for at most 15 minutes.' The only credential source is APW-05's `AppImagePullCredentialSource`, which returns the owner's stored long-lived classic token with `read:packages` (APW-05 plan L812-819). APW-10 plan L240 only seals it with `expiresAt ≤ 15 min`. Nothing mints a short-lived credential, and nothing re-seals one when the controller must re-promote after the envelope expires, so a retry after 15 minutes fails.
gaps.proposedFix: Restate FR-32 as 'a sealed envelope valid ≤ 15 min carrying the per-App-Work read-only token', and define re-sealing: the controller reports `PULL_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED`, and APW-06 re-dispatches `deployApp` with a fresh envelope. Or specify a real short-lived credential source.

gaps.title: Response shapes for PUT preferences and the public platforms route are not in the shared contracts
gaps.evidence: plan.md:365-366 defines PUT /api/me/apps/preferences → `200 { saved, rejected: Array<{key, reason}>, items }`, and plan.md:373-374 defines GET /api/app-launcher/platforms → `{ catalogVersion, environment, platforms }`. The error bodies `422 { code: 'pinLimit', limit: 6 }` and the reasons `unknownItem`/`cannotHideCurrent` appear in plan.md:394-402. T1 (tasks.md:42-52) exports none of these types. The web server action (T16) and the P2 component therefore have no shared type, and T6's `AppLauncherPinLimitError` has no file.
gaps.proposedFix: Extend plan §3.3 and T1 with AppLauncherSavePreferencesResponse, AppLauncherRejectionReason ('unknownItem' | 'cannotHideCurrent'), AppLauncherPlatformsResponse and AppLauncherPinLimitErrorBody, and name the error class file (packages/agent/src/app-launcher/app-launcher.errors.ts).

gaps.title: i18n keys land after the components that use them, and some strings have no key
gaps.evidence: README.md:300-301 rule 11 requires keys 'added to all locale files in the same PR', and tasks.md:22 says develop stays green and deployable per phase and each task is one PR. T14, T16 and T17 ship components using dashboard.appLauncher.*, dashboard.settings.appLauncher.* and workDetail keys, but the keys arrive only in T19 (tasks.md:339-347). plan §8 has no key for the disabled-control tooltip on chunk-load failure (plan.md:686), the Manage apps 'Ever apps' heading and the 'Hidden by the Work' row action, or accessible names for the Show/Pin toggles and drag handle.
gaps.proposedFix: Move each key group into the task that first uses it (T14, T16, T17), with T19 reduced to the cross-locale completeness spec. Add the missing keys to plan §8.

gaps.title: User docs and the plan's known-gaps note contradict the spec and ACCEPTANCE
gaps.evidence: docs/specs/features/app-works/user-docs/app-works.md:137 says 'Turn on **Show in App Launcher** in an App Work's settings to add its live URL', but spec FR-19 defaults App Works to on and ACC-11-09 asserts they appear 'with no setting changed'. plan.md:804-807 says ACCEPTANCE E2E-12 asserts app.launcher events after hiding and pinning, but ACCEPTANCE.md:556-559 now says hide and pin write **no** Activity and the events come from toggling the Work setting, so the flag to the ACCEPTANCE owner is stale.
gaps.proposedFix: Reword user-docs §App Launcher: App Works appear automatically once live, other Works when Show in App Launcher is turned on. Delete or update the stale known-gaps bullet in plan.md.

gaps.title: App Launcher web component repository and npm scope are undecided
gaps.evidence: README section 8 question 7 defaults to a cross-product package in ever-co; APW-11 T28 is an owner decision to extract packages/app-launcher (private in P1) into a public repository and publish under an owner-chosen npm scope. No repository, npm organization or publish credential is identified. Wave 3 only.
gaps.proposedFix: Owner chooses the repository and npm scope and provisions the publish credential as a names-only secret before APW-11 P2; record the answer in README question 7.

gaps.title: Activity rows have no summary text or display name, and the Activity UI does not know the new action types
gaps.evidence: S1 (spec.md:96) requires Activity to read 'Signed in with Ever ID', and FR-49 (spec.md:310-313) says rows carry the identity's display name. The plan §5.6 table (plan.md:561-570) gives actionType, action and metadata only: no summary strings and no display name. Existing rows set summary (oauth.controller.ts:139). The five new actionTypes are missing from the Activity UI maps (apps/web/src/components/activity-log/ActivityTypeBadge.tsx:5-46, ActivityFilters.tsx:7-23), so they would render with the default badge and no label.
gaps.proposedFix: Add a summary string (English plus key) and a displayName metadata field for each of the eight rows. Add the five actionTypes to TYPE_COLORS, TYPE_TO_I18N and ACTION_TYPES with keys, and include those files in T15 or T45.

gaps.title: The plan gives the transaction cookie two paths, and the account-exists page's e-mail source is undefined
gaps.evidence: plan.md:143 sets ew_everid_txn with Path=/api/auth/ever-id, while plan.md:584 sets both cookies to Path `/`. The emailInUse outcome carries no pending value (plan.md:299), yet the web reads the address 'from the pending cookie' (plan.md:609), and nothing says whether the web seals it itself or stores it in plain form.
gaps.proposedFix: Choose one path per cookie. The pending cookie needs Path / so the locale-prefixed pages can read it. Either add a sealed pending value to the emailInUse outcome or say the web seals the address with its own key and TTL.

gaps.title: A token only in the query string gets 401, not FR-17's 400, on session-only and delegated routes
gaps.evidence: FR-17 requires 400 for a token in a query parameter on any Ever ID or delegated route. plan.md:486-489 and 519-520 attach NoTokenInQueryGuard at controller level or through @DelegatedRead. AuthSessionGuard is a global APP_GUARD registered first (apps/api/src/api.module.ts:380-382) and runs before controller guards, so a request with no Authorization header gets 401 first. APW-11 T25 (APW-11 tasks.md:423-424) asserts 400 tokenInQuery.
gaps.proposedFix: Run the query-token check before authentication: inside AuthSessionGuard for handlers carrying the metadata and for the /api/auth/ever-id prefix, or as middleware. Alternatively, state that the 400 applies only after authentication and align APW-11 T25.

gaps.title: T16's grep-based Done-when already fails on develop
gaps.evidence: tasks.md:214-215 requires that a grep of apps/api/src 'finds no authMethod value other than session, api-key and ever-id-delegated'. apps/api/src/plugins-capabilities/git-provider/git-provider.service.ts:13 and 71 already use an unrelated authMethod field with values 'oauth' and 'personal-access-token'.
gaps.proposedFix: Scope the check to AuthenticatedUser.authMethod: the union in apps/api/src/auth/types/auth.types.ts plus the stamps in auth-session.guard.ts. Or assert it in a type-level spec instead of a repo-wide grep.

gaps.title: T11's Done-when needs a copy of the stage database schema, which no lane has
gaps.evidence: tasks.md:162: 'a fresh database and a copy of stage's schema both migrate up and down cleanly'. No lane in ACCEPTANCE §0.1 provides a stage schema copy, and the constraint is not met by the named migration specs.
gaps.proposedFix: Replace it with checks runnable locally or in CI: the two migration specs pass, and a DATABASE_AUTOMIGRATE boot on SQLite and on a Postgres service container runs up and down.

gaps.title: Public docs describe an existing session-token hand-off in reproduction-level detail (R-14)
gaps.evidence: plan.md:56 (and EXISTING-SUBSTRATE.md:118) name the exact function, query parameter and allow-list constant through which the local-client hand-off puts a session token into an address; tasks.md:514-516 repeats it. CONTRACTS.md:57 (R-14) requires existing unfixed weaknesses to be described generically in this public repository, and the private research notes treat this hand-off as a weakness.
gaps.proposedFix: Reword generically, for example 'the existing local-client browser hand-off is kept unchanged and is not extended'. Keep file paths only where a task must touch them, without the parameter or constant names.

gaps.title: Constitution and templates contradict R-22 and the real migrations path, with no recorded amendment
gaps.evidence: .specify/memory/constitution.md Principle VI says 'New API endpoint → e2e test in apps/api/test/', and tasks-template T12 uses apps/api/test/[module].e2e-spec.ts. R-22 forbids that location, correctly: apps/api/jest.config.js has rootDir 'src', and ACCEPTANCE §5 notes apps/api/test/*.e2e-spec.ts is wired to no script. Principle V puts migrations in apps/api/src/database/migrations/, but the real path, used by all 73 program citations, is apps/api/src/migrations/. The spec-template gate reads 'Long-running work via Trigger.dev', while Principle IV is provider-neutral. Constitution Governance requires a flagged constitutional gap to be resolved, by amending the constitution or revising the plan, before implementation begins. Plans tick 'VI — Tests' and mention R-22 without recording it as a gap.
gaps.proposedFix: Add a program task (README §6 or APW-13 P0) proposing a constitution PATCH 1.0.1 with a rationale section. It updates the Principle VI implication (API behaviour tested by controller/service specs under apps/api/src/** or request-level Playwright in apps/web/e2e/), the Principle V path (apps/api/src/migrations/), tasks-template T12, and the spec-template Principle IV gate wording. Until it merges, each plan's VI checklist line says 'Constitutional gap flagged (R-22); amendment PR: <link>'.
